help.key_digits: 0–9 — type the fret number (two digits within under a second combine into one, e.g. 1 then 2 writes fret 12)
help.key_techniques: A letter (or < and /) arms a playing technique and sets it on the selection, like its palette button: each key is written on its button and in the legend above
help.key_space: Space — turn the selected beat into a rest
help.key_arrows: Arrow keys — Up/Down changes string, Left/Right changes beat, and the view scrolls to follow the selection
help.key_range_select: Shift + click or Shift + arrow keys — extend the selection to a range of beats, for Copy/Cut/Paste. A range takes the palette's techniques, strums, palm mute and let ring, Space and Rest (clear), Backspace (the cursor's string), and Transpose (⌥↑ / ⌥↓), all at once; Cmd+A selects the whole piece.
help.key_duration: + / − — longer or shorter note value, . — dotted
help.key_zoom: Ctrl + scroll, or pinch — zoom the page
help.key_live: In live mode: Space — play or pause, ← / → — previous or next bar, A then B — loop from the bar playing at A to the one playing at B, L — loop on or off, Esc — leave. Bars selected in the editor (Shift + click) before opening live mode become the loop.
help.spans_title: Palm mute, let ring, and repeats
help.spans_body: Palm mute and let ring apply to everything sounding at a beat, not to a single note: toggle them in the tool palette for the selected beat, and they print as a labelled dashed span. Repeats belong to bars: select the bars (Shift + click), then Bar > Repeat the selection, or right-click the score, or the palette. The closing repeat sets how many times the passage plays (×2 to ×8), and the live player plays it that many times. The same menu inserts, duplicates and deletes bars.
help.rows_body: The Rows menu picks which rows each block stacks and in what order, top to bottom. The choice is saved in the file.
help.row_tab_desc: the six strings and fret numbers; always shown, it is where notes are placed.
help.row_rhythm_desc: stems, beams and rests, so a block without a staff still says when to play.
help.row_notation_desc: the five-line staff in standard notation.
help.row_chords_desc: chord names, recognised from the notes played together.
tuning_label.strings: At the start of each string
dialog.retune_body:
What should happen to the notes already written?
• Keep the frets: the tablature stays as written and sounds in the new tuning.
• Keep the pitches: every note is re-fretted to sound the same.
Notes on a string that disappears, or that no string can play, are deleted. Undo brings them back.
